status_definitions.VALIDATED: Empirical evidence demonstrates economically meaningful incremental value over a simpler baseline.
status_definitions.RESEARCH_ONLY: Experimental and prohibited from affecting production decisions, sizing, reports, or email.
status_definitions.REJECTED: Tested and not worth its incremental complexity.
status_definitions.CORE_RISK_CONTROL: Primarily protects operational safety; this is not an alpha-validation claim.
status_definitions.UNASSESSED: Evidence is missing or insufficient; existing production presence is not validation.

filters.name: Stage 2 structure
filters.production_effect: Candidate discovery gate before the canonical final decision.
filters.evidence_summary: Implemented; no repository evidence establishes incremental out-of-sample value.
filters.notes: Do not infer validation from production presence.

filters.name: Recent relative strength
filters.production_effect: Primary-edge gate and ranking input; missing or sufficiently weak values block actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=70 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 263 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.216R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.402 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 29.281R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Requires independent point-in-time validation; do not change production from the biased discovery result.

filters.name: Long-term relative strength
filters.production_effect: Candidate scoring, ordering, and leadership context.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found the fixed >=75 rule worse than MODEL_0; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 278 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.280R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.484 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 25.516R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test jointly with Recent RS using independent point-in-time data.

filters.name: Market regime
filters.production_effect: Controls new-risk permission and heat and contributes market context.
filters.evidence_summary: Operational behavior is tested; incremental expectancy/drawdown evidence for the model is not recorded.
filters.notes: Risk purpose does not automatically validate current regime thresholds.

filters.name: Industry qualification
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation and ranking; incomplete coverage cannot silently grant confirmation.
filters.evidence_summary: Synthetic ranking invariants exist; no out-of-sample trade ablation is recorded.
filters.notes: Historical point-in-time classification coverage is a known limitation.

filters.name: Sister-stock confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF but cannot repair failed primary edge.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased 2017-2023 engineering discovery found little incremental value for the fixed >=0.30 rule; this is not validation evidence.
filters.discovery_result: 261 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.317R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.576 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown unchanged at 22.284R.
filters.notes: Requires point-in-time industry membership and breadth.

filters.name: Setup tightness
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category consistency, ranking, and actionability.
filters.evidence_summary: Semantic behavior is tested; no empirical expectancy delta is recorded.
filters.notes: Test with VCP and pullback features for correlated complexity.

filters.name: VCP quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Measure interaction with tightness before promotion or removal.

filters.name: Pullback quality
filters.production_effect: Contributes setup integrity, category ordering, and report ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Evaluate both alpha and trade-frequency effects.

filters.name: Volume confirmation
filters.production_effect: Secondary confirmation that may reduce FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. Test threshold stability and interaction with setup type on independent data.

filters.name: Structural reward/risk
filters.production_effect: A valid observed target and configured minimum structural R/R are hard actionability gates.
filters.evidence_summary: Risk semantics are invariant-tested; the threshold lacks recorded out-of-sample ablation evidence.
filters.notes: Synthetic model targets cannot masquerade as observed resistance.

filters.name: Distance from pivot
filters.production_effect: Contributes entry timing and ranking.
filters.evidence_summary: No controlled ablation result is recorded.
filters.notes: Requires an observable point-in-time pivot definition.

filters.name: Entry timing
filters.production_effect: Blocks overextended entries and can reduce otherwise valid setups from FULL to HALF.
filters.evidence_summary: A survivorship-biased engineering proxy test of the current EMA/high extension limits reduced drawdown but not expectancy; detailed entry timing remains untested.
filters.discovery_result: 255 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.324R versus 0.348R baseline; maximum drawdown 18.276R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Remain UNASSESSED. This was only an extension-limit proxy with next-session execution, not the full entry-timing state machine.

filters.name: Exclude low-beta stocks
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: A fixed rolling-beta >=0.8 rule underperformed in survivorship-biased engineering discovery.
filters.discovery_result: 274 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.215R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.371 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 21.795R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Do not promote. Beta used 126 sessions through the signal date; independent validation is unavailable.

filters.name: Exclude Utilities sector
filters.production_effect: NONE; requested hypothesis only.
filters.evidence_summary: Excluding Utilities improved expectancy and drawdown in survivorship-biased discovery, but classifications were current rather than effective-dated.
filters.discovery_result: 256 capacity-limited trades; expectancy 0.414R versus 0.348R baseline; profit factor 1.758 versus 1.644; maximum drawdown 18.276R versus 22.284R.
filters.notes: Promising discovery only. Requires effective-dated sector classification and independent validation before production review.

filters.name: Critical data validity and freshness
filters.production_effect: Missing, stale, anomalous, or incomplete critical data blocks actionability or publication.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by data-quality, regression, and semantic-invariant tests.

filters.name: Valid structural stop
filters.production_effect: Invalid or unavailable stops block actionability and sizing.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by decision and report invariant tests.

filters.name: Portfolio heat and concentration
filters.production_effect: Caps total, industry, and theme risk and may block otherwise actionable candidates.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Covered by decision and production-integrity tests.

filters.name: Maximum simultaneous positions
filters.production_effect: Blocks new positions once the configured hard cap is reached.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety, not claimed alpha.
filters.notes: Current configured default is four.

filters.name: Drawdown risk modes
filters.production_effect: Reduces or stops new risk as account drawdown increases.
filters.evidence_summary: Classified for operational safety; current calibration is not claimed empirically optimal.
filters.notes: Separate correctness of enforcement from empirical calibration.
